name: M3-4-3-tasks-height-780
steps: const h=window.__sim.host,base=h.tasks.find(t=>t.title.startsWith('Fix the flaky')); for(const t of h.tasks)h.emit({type:'task_upserted',task:{...t,state:'completed'}}); h.control=h.control.map(v=>({...v,input_state:'ready',lease:null}));for(const view of h.control)h.emit({type:'control_changed',view}); h.tasks=Array.from({length:3},(_,i)=>({...base,task_id:'proof-task-'+i,title:'Running task '+(i+1),state:'working',mode:'ask'}));for(const task of h.tasks)h.emit({type:'task_upserted',task})
